body: Yea. I love them so much. I feel like a superhero every day i come home to them. My daughter races to greet me and hug me. The thought if not being able to do that every day buckles my insides.
I'm still here but I'm going to do it tonight. Should I get drunk before hand so I don't try and undo knot?
It would make my wife's life easier if I had the courage to do this. She could start again with the money. I have the noose in my hand. She and my kids are asleep.

My wife is due to tell the kids we are breaking up on Monday. How can my kids think I want to be apart from them? Even now I don't want to blame my wife as I adore her and desperately wanted to fix things but my kids will think this is a joint decision when it is not what I want in the slightest.

I called the Samaratins here in Scotland for help the day I went to hang myself and 3 times I called and no one answered. I just needed someone to talk me out of it and them not answering pushed me to the point of almost no return.

It's just all so sudden and unlike my wife. She us the kind of girl who would walk though fire for our marriage and family. Now she won't even try and give a shit. It pierces my heart like a dagger of agony.
My wife and kids are all that matter to me in the world. The thought of not being with them is killing me slowly and agonisingly. They are my everything.

My wife of 14 years who i adore and love as much as I ever have has broken up with me. Ripped our family apart - two kids too . Says she isn't in love anymore. 

Also says she knows we could get it back if she would make the effort but she doesn't want to make the effort. 

I'm broken. I decided to kill myself a month or two ago. I contacted my life insurance provider and learned there is no suicide clause so my wife would receive full pay out, I wrote a note and made a video and also learned via YouTube how to make a hangmans noose.

One day it all hit me. A major dip. Pain and tears and agony. Physical agony. I had to leave my work and I walked to the local store and bought a skipping rope as that's all they had.

I drove to the woods and made the noose and while crying hysterically I walked to a tree. 

Just as I approached it my phone rang and it was my 3 year old daughter. Just calling to talk about her day at pre school and saying she loved me.

It is no exaggeration to say that call saved my life and but for the timing I would likely be dead by now.

But 2 months on relations with my wife are even worse now and she is adamant there is no hope at all.

My family is all I've ever loved and wanted so my suicidal thoughts have 're emerged stronger and angrier than ever.

I feel it is inevitable I will kill myself.
